name: agency-reports
description: Agency-facing reports for Smart Roadways data. React frontend, Django backend.

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: biome check . && cd backend && ruff check . && ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && cd backend && ruff check --fix . && ruff format .
scripts.gen:api: cd backend && python manage.py spectacular --validate --file ../openapi.yaml && cd .. && openapi-typescript openapi.yaml -o frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.check:api: npm run gen:api && git diff --exit-code -- openapi.yaml frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:api
